metadata.title: Pass 3 reference notes for the 3D skin-volume reaction-diffusion model and its depth-averaged (thin-film) reduction used by 2015-manukyan-ocellated-lizard-ca.py

sources.citation: Fofonjka A, Milinkovitch MC (2021). Reaction-diffusion in a growing 3D domain of skin scales generates a discrete cellular automaton. Nature Communications 12:2433.
sources.used_for: Premise that reaction-diffusion in a 3D skin domain whose thickness is reduced at inter-scale borders (thick scale centres, thin borders) discretizes the continuous Turing pattern into scale-level states; the 3D domain in the paper is a reconstructed skin geometry, which is NOT vendored here.

sources.citation: Manukyan L, Montandon SA, Fofonjka A, Smirnov S, Milinkovitch MC (2017). A living mesoscopic cellular automaton made of skin scales. Nature 544(7649):173-179.
sources.used_for: Border thickness reduction factor P = h_border / h_interior ~ 0.17 and the mesoscopic premise that the reaction-diffusion wavelength exceeds the scale size (Fig. 4).

sources.citation: Turing AM (1952). The chemical basis of morphogenesis. Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society of London B 237(641):37-72.
sources.used_for: Linear stability conditions tr J < 0, det J > 0, d f_u + g_v > 2 sqrt(d det J) and the critical diffusivity ratio d_c.

three_d_skin_volume_model.status: closest honest reduced version of the Pass 2 remediation item; NOT a micro-CT finite-element mesh
three_d_skin_volume_model.domain: Omega = {(x, y, z) : 0 <= z < h(x, y)}, h = h_interior inside hexagonal scale cores, h = P * h_interior on inter-scale border pixels (stepped thickness)
three_d_skin_volume_model.governing_equations: du/dt = F(u, v) + D_u Laplacian u ; dv/dt = G(u, v) + D_v Laplacian v in Omega, with zero-flux (Neumann) boundaries on the epidermal surface, the basal lamina and the vertical steps between thick and thin skin; periodic laterally

discretization.scheme: finite-volume voxels; face conductance 1 iff both voxels are skin; explicit lateral diffusion; implicit vertical diffusion (vectorized Thomas / tridiagonal solve) so dz can be refined without a stability penalty
discretization.stability_constraint: explicit lateral: dt < 1 / (4 D_v) = 0.00656 at lambda_c = 25 px, d = 20

kinetics.form: activator-inhibitor kinetics linearized about (u*, v*) = (0.50, 0.50) with cubic activator saturation: F = 0.50 (u - 0.5) - 0.75 (v - 0.5) - 1.25 (u - 0.5)^3 ; G = 0.82 (u - 0.5) - 0.65 (v - 0.5)
kinetics.why_five_pitches: the first zero-flux mode of an isolated ~4 px scale interior (k_1 = pi / 4 = 0.785 px^-1) must lie above the unstable band k_max ~ 1.9 k_c = 0.48 px^-1 so that an insulated scale cannot pattern internally; this is the mesoscopic premise of Manukyan et al. (2017) Fig. 4
kinetics.caveat: these are NOT the Methods parameters of Manukyan et al. (2017); the clipped-linear canonical set vendored in ocellated_lizard_ca_reference.json is kept for traceability but has d_c = 23.57 > its stated d = 20 and is therefore not Turing-unstable as vendored (open Pass 4 item)

thin_film_reduction.depth_averaged_equation: d ubar/dt = F(ubar, vbar) + (1 / h(x)) div( h(x) D_u grad ubar ) ; d vbar/dt = G(ubar, vbar) + (1 / h(x)) div( h(x) D_v grad vbar )
thin_film_reduction.finite_volume_form: face conductance between columns i, j = min(h_i, h_j) * D (shared face area); column capacity = h_i
thin_film_reduction.validity: h_interior << lambda_c (here h_interior = 2.4 px vs lambda_c = 25 px); measured by the vertical non-uniformity RMS of the 3D solution
thin_film_reduction.relation_to_pass2_model: the Pass 2 variant D(x) = P * D on border pixels with unit capacity has the same border conductance but the wrong (unit) border capacity, and additionally applied an artificial per-scale averaging step (homog_rate = 0.28 (1 - P)) after every PDE step; both are removed in Pass 3 (the diffusivity variant is retained only as a comparison, border_model='diffusivity')

residual_gap_for_pass_4: No micro-CT or confocal skin-scale mesh is vendored: the 3D domain is a stepped-thickness voxel skin on a 5 px scale pitch (border area fraction 0.36, far larger than real inter-scale border area), not the reconstructed geometry of Fofonjka & Milinkovitch (2021).
No domain growth: Fofonjka & Milinkovitch (2021) integrate on a growing domain; the Pass 3 volume is static.
Kinetics are a phenomenological Kondo-Asai-type set, not the Methods parameters of Manukyan et al. (2017).
